name: CPMC Information Desk Volunteer (Van Ness Campus, Sutter Health)
org: Sutter Health, California Pacific Medical Center (CPMC)
city: San Francisco, CA (CPMC Van Ness Campus, 1101 Van Ness Avenue)
what_you_do: Help visitors and patients who come into the main lobby at CPMC Van Ness Campus. Give directions, information and help. The listing says the desk is open 24 hours.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 and older. Some departments accept only people 18 and older. Junior volunteers under 18 need a signed parental consent form.
pay_detail: Volunteer role; no pay stated on the listing
duration: Minimum 100 hours in one year, at least three to four hours per week
deadline_text: Junior and high school applications closed March 6, 2026 because spots filled. They open March 1, 2027. Until then the form takes only people 18 and older.
how_to_apply: Starting March 1, 2027, complete the online application, then an in-person interview and a health screening. The background check applies to adults only. Questions go to cpmcvolunteer@sutterhealth.org.
notes: The listing still says Actively Recruiting, but the application form says junior spots are full until March 1, 2027. The listing asks for 100 hours and the form says at least 60, so ask which applies. Applications are reviewed the first week of the next month. It is a lobby role, not a high school program.
